description: Small labelled calibration sample (spec §14) for comparing automated evaluator labels against human labels. 22 hand-labelled examples, two per required category. humanLabels maps an evaluator key to the human pass/fail verdict for that metric on this example (true = passed, false = defect). These numbers describe agreement on this sample only — never call the result 'model accuracy'.
